title: Monomachine, Plaits Macro & Sophie Pack (Digitone)
author: gdeo607 / Emilie Gillet / soejrd / port
description: Nine synth machines ported from Digitakt's digimono, digimacro, and digisophie onto the Digitone mk1's machines-dn1 framework: SAW (SuperWave Saw), PULSE (SuperWave Pulse), ENS (4-oscillator Ensemble + chorus), CHORD (4-oscillator Chord machine), VO-6 (Formant vocal synthesizer), NOISE (Sample & hold / red / tuned noise), PSIN (3-sine poly with pitch env), MACRO (Mutable Instruments Plaits 8 engines: Waveshaping, 2-Op FM, Clocked Noise, Particles, Bass Drum, Snare, Hi-Hat, Formant Grains), and SOPHIE (4 metallic percussion models: FUSE, BOOM, PIPE, SHARD).
